files.list.css: .list-workspace{font-family:system-ui;max-width:64rem;margin:auto;padding:20px}.list-workspace header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}.list-workspace button{font:inherit;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #abb4c3;border-radius:5px;background:white}.list-workspace button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #3e67bf}.list-error{border:1px solid #b03927;border-left:4px solid #b03927;padding:16px;margin-bottom:16px}.list-empty{padding:32px;border:1px dashed #9ca6b8;text-align:center}.list-workspace ul{padding:0;list-style:none}.list-workspace li{padding:16px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}
